description: For material delivery, this issue tracking log records expected quantities, unloading plan, inspection criteria, documentation, protected storage, and installation need date. Its supporting evidence includes packing slip, count, condition photos, certificate, temperature or moisture reading, and discrepancy notice.

subtitle: Material Delivery Issue Tracking Log: material delivery receipt and condition control using purchase order, expected quantities, and packing slip.
title: Material Delivery Issue Tracking Log
use_case: Use the issue tracking log during material delivery receipt and condition control when the material delivery record must identify purchase order, supplier, carrier, delivery location, product identifiers, lot numbers, and storage requirements. Complete the applicable handoff for accepted quantity, shortage or damage claim, inventory location, responsible custodian, and procurement update.
